The patch fixes memory leaks in the function `ceph_mdsc_build_path()` in `fs/ceph/mds_client.c`. The function allocates a buffer with `__getname()` but on three error paths it returned without freeing it via `__putname()`. The three additions release the buffer before returning `ERR_PTR()` on failures from `ceph_fill_trace`, `ceph_encode_encrypted_fname`, and when the path length exceeds `PATH_MAX`. All changes are in the same function, ensuring consistent cleanup of the allocated memory.
